etsy.title: Hairpin Square Flat Rally Car Poster, Pace Notes Wall Art, Corner Types Print, Rally Driver Gift
etsy.description:
A rally car poster that prints three pace-note corner calls in bold stencil type: HAIRPIN, SQUARE, FLAT, with a graphic showing each corner shape.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in and 8×10 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang it in a garage, man cave, home office, or on a rally fan's wall.

An original design with no team, series, or manufacturer marks.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Hairpin-themed Etsy posters are almost all Monaco F1 hairpin prints; no rally pace-note corner-type poster was found.
Rally car poster results are dominated by real-car illustrations and digital downloads; typographic pace-note designs are a gap.
Physical rally prints in snippets ranged from about $18 to $50 USD for comparable poster sizes.
Amazon rally posters are watercolor or photographic prints of real cars, sold unframed in 11x14, A2, and A3 sizes, marketed for garages and man caves.
No typographic pace-note corner-type posters found on Amazon.

research.notes: Keyword phrases from research/keywords/rally.json (search-results, 2026-11-01). 'hairpin rally car poster' combines the design's lead word with the strongest indexed phrase. 'corner types poster' has no evidence as a search phrase; it describes the design. Hairpin Etsy results skew to F1 Monaco, not rally. Price range from physical poster snippets across rally results.
